annotations.title: Check how an audit is going

description: Read audit status, changed progress, server elapsed time and ranked findings with typed edits. Use wait:25 while running. A failed, cancelled or stalled run is not a finished report. Once complete, use run_cro_skill or ask_audit for the relevant buyer, copy or offer evidence. Reading does not authorise a redesign.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a material change. Use 25 for broad client compatibility; longer waits are available for hosts that support them. A timeout preserves the run; resume by ID instead of starting again.
